title: Chlorine disinfection enhances the degradation of biodegradable microplastics into nanoplastics and dissolved organic carbon in a simulated disinfection process
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00030D, Paper
Xuefeng Jiang, Jianxin Fan, Siyu Xu, Bocong Huang, Jiaoxia Sun
NaClO disinfection unexpectedly accelerated PLA and PBAT MPs physical and chemical degradation, which significantly increased surface fracturing, oxygenation and release of NPs into effluent, highlighting a critical gap in wastewater strategies.
